# Radoslav Ďurač

> Slovak digital accessibility specialist and NVDA Certified Expert focused on WCAG, EN 301 549 and accessible PDF documents (PDF/UA). Based in Bratislava, works in Slovak and English. This page is also available in Slovak: https://rraddatch.github.io/sk/ (llms.txt: https://rraddatch.github.io/sk/llms.txt).

Radoslav Ďurač works on the accessibility of websites, mobile applications, non-web documents, and digital products and services. He focuses on accessibility auditing and compliance with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2, EN 301 549, WAI-ARIA and PDF/UA, as well as European and Slovak accessibility legislation (EAA, WAD, Act No. 95/2019 Coll. on ITVS, Decree No. 78/2020 Coll.). He holds the NVDA Certified Expert certification from NV Access, confirming expert knowledge of the NVDA screen reader.

## Open source and projects

- [Able Player](https://github.com/ableplayer/ableplayer): author of the Slovak translation for the open source accessible media player, and fix for a bug in the getTranslationText() function; the contribution is listed in the changelog for version 5.0.0
- [Autogram](https://github.com/slovensko-digital/autogram): collaboration on the accessibility of the electronic document signing application, its mobile version, and its browser extension

## Standards and legislation

- [WCAG 2.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/): Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1
- [WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/): Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2

## Certifications

- [NVDA Certified Expert](https://certification.nvaccess.org/): certification from NV Access confirming expert knowledge of the NVDA screen reader

## Education and memberships
